ayuda.subtitulo: SIGAP works with access authorized by each congregation. Here are the most common answers before you sign in.

q1.r: It's the IPUC's pastoral management system: membership census, committees, evangelism, and reports, with a view suited to each level — local, district, and national.

q2.p: How do I get access if my congregation already uses SIGAP?
q2.r: Ask your congregation's pastor to create your access from "Team" — there they choose your email and the profile you'll operate, and the invitation arrives by email.

q3.p: What if my congregation has never used SIGAP?
q3.r: In that case your district leader creates it, not a public sign-up: they create the congregation along with the pastor's details from "District Pastoral Management", and the pastor gets a real invitation by email to activate their account.

q4.p: Can I sign up without an invitation?
q4.r: No. Open sign-up is disabled to protect congregations' information — every access comes from a real invitation, either from your pastor (if your congregation already uses SIGAP) or from your district leader (if it's the first time).

q5.p: What do I do if I forgot my password?
q5.r: Use the "Forgot your password?" option on the sign-in screen to get a recovery link by email.

q6.p: Can I use SIGAP from my phone?
q6.r: Yes, it works from any phone or computer browser — nothing to install.

q1.p: Why don't I see a module I expected?
q1.r: Modules depend on your congregation, your level (local, district, national), and the access profile assigned to you. If you think you should have it, check with your congregation's administrator.

q2.p: My name shows up differently than expected, how do I fix it?
q2.r: Go to "My profile" (user icon, top right) and correct your First/Last name there — it updates across the whole app, including the census.

q3.p: How do I give access to someone else in my congregation?
q3.r: From "Team" (only the pastor sees it), select the person in the census, their email, and the access profile they need.

q4.p: What happens if someone transfers to another congregation?
q4.r: From the person's record in Membership you can start a transfer — the receiving congregation confirms it, and the person's full history travels with them, nothing is lost.

q5.p: How do I contact my district or national leadership?
q5.r: Use "Internal requests" — it's a formal channel (not a chat) to ask for something, report a situation, or make a suggestion, with status tracking until it's resolved.

q1.p: Are my data and the census data secure?
q1.r: Yes — access is protected by authentication, each congregation only sees its own information, and higher levels only see what falls within their scope. More detail in Privacy and terms.

q2.p: I found a bug or something isn't working, what do I do?
q2.r: Once you have access, use "Support" inside the app to report it — it gets logged and a direct alert reaches the team that maintains SIGAP. You can also write to soportesigasoftware@gmail.com.

q3.p: What do I do if my congregation shows as "pending approval"?
q3.r: New congregations are activated by the corresponding district leader from "Approvals". If it's been pending a long time, contact your district leader.

pastoralAgenda.agendaPastoralTip: Here you see all of your congregation's pastoral follow-up in one place: below, 'Follow-up agenda' shows what YOU scheduled (from a person's record) and 'Pending alerts' shows what SIGAP detects on its own, without anyone scheduling it (e.g. someone hasn't attended in 90 days). Handling an alert also logs it in your Agenda.
pastoralAgenda.consultaEstado: Check the status of your scheduled follow-ups.
pastoralAgenda.sinAlertasNiVencidos: There are no high-priority alerts or overdue follow-ups right now.
pastoralAgenda.agendaAcompanamientoDesc: Follow-ups you logged yourself, by hand, from a person's record -- scheduled, overdue, and upcoming.
pastoralAgenda.alertasPendientesTip: SIGAP generates these alerts on its own, without anyone scheduling them, when it detects a situation that needs attention (for example: someone hasn't attended in 90 days, or is pending baptism). 'Handle' opens a form to log what you did -- that gets saved in your Agenda above. For attendance alerts there's also 'Confirm contact today', a shortcut with no form for when you already spoke with the person.
pastoralAgenda.detectadasAutomaticamente: Automatically detected -- you didn't schedule these.

committeeFilters.filtrarComitesTip: 'Current' committees are marked active and have not yet reached their end date (or have none). 'Expired' ones already passed their end date, even if still marked active -- useful for finding committees you should deactivate or extend.

committeeCreateForm.codigoInternoTip: A code or acronym your congregation uses to identify this committee in its own files (for example, in minutes or physical folders). It is optional and you decide the format -- SIGAP does not use it for anything else.
committeeCreateForm.tipoTip: Classifies the committee using the types you configured in Settings → Committee types (for example: Evangelism, Construction, Education). It is optional and only used to group/filter -- if you haven't configured types, leave it as 'No type'.
committeeCreateForm.fechaFinalizacionTip: Only fill it in if you already know when this committee ends (for example, one organized for a one-time event). Leave it empty if it is a permanent committee.
committeeCreateForm.descripcionTip: What this committee is, in a few words -- so anyone who sees it understands what it is about.
committeeCreateForm.descripcionPlaceholder: E.g: Group in charge of organizing door-to-door evangelism visits in the neighborhood.
committeeCreateForm.propositoTip: What it exists for -- the objective or outcome this committee seeks (different from the description, which says what it IS; the purpose says WHAT FOR).
committeeCreateForm.propositoPlaceholder: E.g: Increase church attendance through weekly visits to families in the area.
committeeCreateForm.observacionesPlaceholder: Notes, agreements, or relevant decisions about this committee (optional).

pastoralFollowupPanel.seguimientoPastoralTip: Log any follow-up you do with this person here (call, visit, conversation). It is saved in their history and, if you schedule a next contact, it also appears in the 'Follow-up agenda' of the Pastoral Follow-up tab.

pastoralFollowupPanel.accionPlaceholder: E.g: Called to ask how the family is doing
pastoralFollowupPanel.proximoContactoTip: If you fill it in, this follow-up stays pending in your Agenda until that date. If left empty, it is marked completed right away.
pastoralFollowupPanel.notasPlaceholder: E.g: Showed interest, follow up in two weeks.
